scope: raw bundled JSON only; files whose basename begins with '_' are excluded exactly as NodeDefinitionLoader.scanPath/scanJar do
sourceTreeHashAlgorithm: SHA-256(UTF-8(join(sorted relative-path records, '\n') + '\n')); each record is lowercase SHA-256 file hash, two ASCII spaces, and slash-normalized path relative to nodes
countingAlgorithm: For each eligible JSON root object or array element, count every physical object in inputs and outputs when the property exists. A missing property contributes zero physical entries. The separately reported logical count adds one undocumented implicit input for each definition without an inputs property, matching the published 7,278 predicate.
conclusion: The five-pin delta is fully explained: five definitions omit inputs rather than declaring an empty array. The published 7,278/6,220 baseline counts one implicit, undocumented input for each; the raw physical JSON-entry inventory is 7,273/6,215. NodeDefinitionLoader does not add these inputs, so the implicit count is a baseline logical/audit convention rather than a runtime loader value. Loader-inferred fields are deliberately excluded.
